requirement_text:
The UI of the application looks so old and legacy. use bootstrap to revamp all the UI Component and make the UI Looks way better and readable, update all the components, like the navigation menu, dashboard, tables and footer and other components.
this should not break existing workflow. this is for the UI enhancement. so act as an senior frontend engineer and make the changes.

requirements.text: Revamp the application UI components using Bootstrap to modernize the legacy design.
Update specific UI elements including the navigation menu, dashboard, tables, and footer.
Improve visual readability and aesthetics throughout the application.
Ensure the UI enhancement does not break existing functional workflows.
